TOKEN_HEALTH.Help: Enter applies. Positive = damage, negative = healing. Typed damage: 5[cold]+10[fire]. Shift+Enter with -10 adds 10 Temp HP.
TOKEN_HEALTH.toggleKeyHint: Opens the damage/healing dialog for the selected tokens. Hold Alt to use your targets instead.
TOKEN_HEALTH.Title: Stef's Token Health ({count} {scope})

HelpBody.dnd5e: Enter applies. Positive = damage, negative = healing. Typed damage: 5[cold]+10[fire]. Shift+Enter with -10 adds 10 Temp HP.
HelpBody.drawSteel: Enter applies. Positive = damage, negative = healing (Stamina). Typed damage: 5[cold]+10[fire] — each segment is a separate damage instance, so immunity and weakness apply to each. Types: {types}. Shift+Enter with -10 sets Temporary Stamina to 10 (highest wins; healing a minion heals its squad's shared Stamina once, up to the squad's max, and revives defeated minions the pool covers again; minions cannot gain Temporary Stamina).

Warn.OldModuleActive: The old Token Health module is also active. Both open on Enter, so disable Token Health in Module Management.
Warn.UnsupportedSystem: No adapter is registered for the "{system}" game system.
Warn.TempUnsupported: This system does not support temporary hit points.
Warn.TempNeedsNegative: Temp mode requires a plain negative number (e.g. -10).
Warn.NoValidTargets: None of the selected tokens have a health resource.

Error.NegativeTyped: Typed expressions cannot be negative. Use a plain negative number for healing.
